description: A long-meeting check, about 25 minutes: the talk, then a question every minute or so. It crosses the voice model's ten-minute connection limit twice, and three questions (12, 20 and 21) can only be answered from earlier in the session.

after.label: question 1
after.say: Can it join a Zoom call today?

after.label: question 2
after.say: My name is Henry, by the way. Please remember it.

after.label: question 3
after.say: What is Stand not?

after.label: question 4
after.say: How much does it cost?

after.label: question 5
after.say: Why does voice matter so much to you?

after.label: question 6
after.say: Who made you?

after.label: question 7
after.say: What do you mean by a character and a goal?

after.label: question 8
after.say: Can you see my screen?

after.label: question 9
after.say: What happens next for Stand?

after.label: question 10
after.say: Can you tell who is speaking right now?

after.label: question 11
after.say: Is Stand a note taker?

after.label: question 12
after.say: What is my name?

after.label: question 13
after.say: Where does the name Stand come from?

after.label: question 14
after.say: What is the first test Stand has to pass?

after.label: question 15
after.say: Does it replace the person in the meeting?

after.label: question 16
after.say: Which voice model are you running on?

after.label: question 17
after.say: How is Stand put together?

after.label: question 18
after.say: What can't you do yet?

after.label: question 19
after.say: When will it be released?

after.label: question 20
after.say: What was the very first thing I asked you after your talk?

after.label: question 21
after.say: And what is my name again?

goodbye.label: goodbye
goodbye.say: Thanks, that's all the questions we have.
